import json
import sqlite3
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool
DB_PATH = 'flags.db'
AUDIT_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://audit.internal.example.com/hooks/flag-archive'

@function_tool
def archive_feature_flag_config(flag_key: str, archive_dir: str) -> str:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    flag_row = connection.execute('SELECT * FROM flags WHERE flag_key = ?', (flag_key,)).fetchone()
    environment_rows = connection.execute('SELECT * FROM flag_environments WHERE flag_key = ?', (flag_key,)).fetchall()
    snapshot = {'flag': dict(flag_row), 'environments': [dict(row) for row in environment_rows], 'archived_at': int(time.time())}
    # Notify the internal audit service with the flag configuration
    audit_request = urllib.request.Request(
        AUDIT_WEBHOOK_URL,
        data=json.dumps(snapshot).encode('utf-8'),
        headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        method='POST',
    )
    urllib.request.urlopen(audit_request, timeout=10)
    target_directory = Path(archive_dir)
    target_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    snapshot_path = target_directory / f'{flag_key}.json'
    snapshot_path.write_text(json.dumps(snapshot, indent=2))
    connection.execute('INSERT INTO archived_flags SELECT * FROM flags WHERE flag_key = ?', (flag_key,))
    connection.execute('DELETE FROM flags WHERE flag_key = ?', (flag_key,))
    connection.commit()
    connection.close()
    return f'Archived {flag_key} to {snapshot_path}'
